p: Provides a collection of mathematical utility functions and constants optimized for performance.
h3: Deg2Rad (float) = MathF.PI / 180: A constant factor used to convert an angle measurement from degrees to radians.
Rad2Deg (float) = 180 / MathF.PI: A constant factor used to convert an angle measurement from radians to degrees.

pre.code: public static bool ApproximatelyEquals(float value1, float value2)

p: Determines whether two floating-point numbers are approximately equal, accounting for precision limitations.

ul.li: value1 (float): The first value to compare.
value2 (float): The second value to compare.
True if the absolute difference between the two values is less than the smallest positive single precision number; otherwise, false.

pre.code: public static bool ApproximatelyEquals(Vector2 a, Vector2 b)

p: Determines whether two floating-point vectors are approximately equal, accounting for precision limitations.

ul.li: a (Vector2): The first vector to compare.
b (Vector2): The second vector to compare.
True if all corresponding components of the vectors are approximately equal; otherwise, false.

pre.code: public static float Lerp(float a, float b, float duration)

p: Linearly interpolates between two values based on a specified interpolation factor.

ul.li: duration (float): The interpolation factor, typically in the range [0, 1]. A value of 0 will return a, and a value of 1 will return b.
The interpolated value between a and b based on duration.

p: Clamps the given value to the range [0, 1].

ul.li: value (float): The value to be clamped.
